assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE 1000x760 landscape game-card ARTWORK ONLY. IMAGE1 is STRICT crouched POSE and enormous vertical wind-blade reference. IMAGE2 is ONLY Wylder costume/helmet identity, NOT idle pose or detailed sprite rendering. IMAGE3 controls graphic flat game-card style. Wylder is a SMALL compressed BACK-LEFT three-quarter figure in LOWER-LEFT (about30% frame), body crouching deep, back arched, helmet looking DOWN-RIGHT, near knee folded high, front boot planted. No upright stance, airborne backflip, or forward-flip landing. Two bent arms tuck close to body, both brown gloved hands at low-left control ONE straight greatsword angled UP-RIGHT from low grip toward wind-wave origin. Keep shoulders/elbows/wrists anatomically connected. Normal Wylder weapon is a LONG RIGID STRAIGHT silver greatsword, navy grip, compact guard, sculptural FORKED silver pommel; grip/guard/blade all collinear. Do NOT bend physical blade to match the curved wind. A SEPARATE ENORMOUS UPRIGHT gray-white CRESCENT VACUUM BLADE fills RIGHT TWO-THIRDS from top to bottom, fired FORWARD/RIGHT from the low sword motion. Outer edge is sharp convex crescent on right, open side faces left, 2-3 broad swept inner wind bands lead from crouching knight toward curved outer edge, matching IMAGE1. It is a single forward-moving vertical cutting wave, NOT a complete ring wrapping around character, NOT a top-down white slash pillar, not a fire explosion. Use hard flat ivory/ice-gray bands with dark slate negative cuts, no airbrushed wisps or glitter. Subject costume: CLOSED silver feather-wing helmet and blue back/nape plate, black scarf, navy split skirt with sparse WHITE flowing motifs, grouped silver scales, brown wraps. Show BACK fabric, do not put V-shaped FRONT breastplate on back. Wind wave is primary event; smaller crouching knight establishes cause. Minimal DEEP MUTED PETROL/SLATE background with one low-contrast ground plane, broad calm negative space upper-left, no rubble/scenery/pillars. Contrast the enormous cool pale blade against gray-teal dark field. Graphic FLAT2D fantasy card illustration: chunky shapes, bold BLACK shadows, limited palette, 2-3 LARGE HARD-EDGE CEL planes per material. No detailed engraving, realistic texture/metal, cinematic fog, full battlefield, UI/text, border, extra hands or blades. Important: it must look different from a grounded flip-slam: tiny BACK-VIEW knight low-left launching huge curved wind forward, not large frontal knight landing beside a vertical beam.
